title: Resisting Political Divisiveness and Conforming To Fear
fullTitle: Soul Feast #46: Resisting Political Divisiveness and Conforming To Fear
description: Create the life you desire by choosing love over fear. Learn how HERE.

When political chaos surrounds us and fear seems to dominate public discourse, how can we respond from a place of love? In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav explores how both resisting political divisiveness and conforming to fear are expressions of the same underlying energy: fear itself. He offers listeners a powerful reframing of current events, emphasizing that our external world reflects our internal awareness – and that real change always begins within.
Whether we conform to the fear around us or attempt to resist the divisiveness we see, we are still often reacting from fear.

The path forward lies not in ignoring or fighting fear, but in consciously choosing to act from a loving part of your personality instead – by recognizing the frightened parts of our personality and shifting toward emotional awareness and responsible choice.

Creating authentic power doesn’t require the external world to become peaceful first – it begins by choosing love even when fear is present. When we cease blaming the external world and instead begin to examine our internal reactions, we gain the capacity to respond with compassion, clarity, and courage. The choice is always ours to make.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:
(01:05) — What It Means to Conform to Fear: How fear disguises itself as anger, judgment, competition—and what happens when we unconsciously join it
(05:03) — Reading the Signals: Where fear shows up in your body and how to recognize frightened parts of your personality
(07:50) — Love vs. Fear: Why choosing love is the foundation of authentic power and the key to personal transformation
(09:56) — The Illusion of Divisiveness: How political divisiveness is a mirror of our inner landscape—not a fixed external reality
(13:45) — The Shift Toward Authentic Power: Why changing yourself is the most powerful way to change the world
(20:06) — Your Role in the New Human Consciousness: How to align your personality with your soul and live from harmony, cooperation, and reverence for life

This week, carry a small notebook with you. Each time you have a reaction to political divisiveness – whether it’s anger, fear, frustration, or judgment – write it down. Note the frightened parts of your personality that arise, even if you only fear the idea of conforming to fear. At the end of the week, reflect on what you’ve written. Recognize that you are the one who experienced these reactions – and you are the one with the power to choose differently. This is where authentic power is born: not from changing the world, but from choosing love in each moment.
